items.raw_excerpt: Traffic snarls around Bengaluru schools strain buses, residents, and academics; micro-planning and heavier-vehicle restrictions seek relief.

items.raw_excerpt: The council says the plaza, which will require the demolition of several buildings the city has obtained since the 1980s, is necessary to create a gathering point for community events, music events and markets.
